plugins.name: ansight
plugins.description: Let your agent build, test, and prove your app works: 27 Ansight CLI skills, a verifier subagent, and a session-start readiness check for mobile apps.

skills.name: ansight-annotate-session
skills.description: Add, update, verify, or remove timeline and UI-anchored annotations on one Ansight session. Use for requested review metadata, screenshot geometry, or visual-tree target binding; do not use merely to read annotations, investigate evidence, or operate the live app.
headings: Add A Timeline Annotation With The CLI
Write A UI Annotation From A CLI JSON File
Use Diagnostic Annotation Tools Without Mixing Schemas
Preserve Existing Annotations During CLI Updates
skills.description_zh: 添加、更新、验证或删除单个 Ansight 会话的时间线和 UI 锚定注释，用于审阅元数据、截图几何或视觉树目标绑定；不用于仅查看注释、调查证据或操作实时应用。

skills.name: ansight-app-inspection-android
skills.description: Add native Android Kotlin and Java semantics to an Ansight operation. Use alongside a selected core Ansight workflow when Android view or Compose rendering, preferences, storage, reflection, ADB fallback, or Android tool behavior affects interpretation; do not use as the primary live-operation, remote-tool, session-investigation, or annotation workflow.
headings: Keep The Core Workflow In Charge
skills.description_zh: 为已选 Ansight 核心流程补充 Android Kotlin/Java 平台语义，解释 View/Compose 渲染、偏好、存储、反射、ADB 后备及工具行为；不是实时操作、远程工具、会话调查或注释的主流程。

skills.name: ansight-app-inspection-cordova
skills.description: Add Capacitor DOM and native-platform semantics to an Ansight operation. Use alongside a selected core Ansight workflow when WebView DOM, JavaScript errors, native hierarchy, bridge state, or DOM tool behavior affects interpretation; do not use as the primary live-operation, remote-tool, session-investigation, or annotation workflow.
headings: Keep The Core Workflow In Charge
skills.description_zh: 为已选 Ansight 核心流程补充 Capacitor DOM 与原生平台语义，解释 WebView DOM、JS 错误、原生层级、桥状态及工具行为；不是实时操作、远程工具、会话调查或注释的主流程。

skills.name: ansight-app-inspection-dotnet
skills.description: Add .NET MAUI and .NET mobile platform semantics to an Ansight operation. Use alongside a selected core Ansight workflow when MAUI hierarchy, bindings, handlers, native rendering, reflection, or .NET tool behavior affects interpretation; do not use as the primary live-operation, remote-tool, session-investigation, or annotation workflow.
headings: Keep The Core Workflow In Charge
skills.description_zh: 为已选 Ansight 核心流程补充 .NET MAUI 和移动平台语义，解释层级、绑定、处理器、原生渲染、反射及工具行为；不是实时操作、远程工具、会话调查或注释的主流程。

skills.name: ansight-app-inspection-flutter
skills.description: Add Flutter widget and native-platform semantics to an Ansight operation. Use alongside a selected core Ansight workflow when widget hierarchy, navigation, native rendering, physical-device logging, or Flutter tool behavior affects interpretation; do not use as the primary live-operation, remote-tool, session-investigation, or annotation workflow.
headings: Keep The Core Workflow In Charge
skills.description_zh: 为已选 Ansight 核心流程补充 Flutter 组件与原生平台语义，解释组件层级、导航、原生渲染、实体设备日志及工具行为；不是实时操作、远程工具、会话调查或注释的主流程。

skills.name: ansight-app-inspection-ios
skills.description: Add native iOS SwiftUI and UIKit semantics to an Ansight operation. Use alongside a selected core Ansight workflow when UIKit hierarchy, SwiftUI hosting, Apple storage, Simulator control, reflection, or iOS tool behavior affects interpretation; do not use as the primary live-operation, remote-tool, session-investigation, or annotation workflow.
headings: Keep The Core Workflow In Charge
skills.description_zh: 为已选 Ansight 核心流程补充 iOS SwiftUI/UIKit 语义，解释层级、SwiftUI 托管、Apple 存储、模拟器控制、反射及工具行为；不是实时操作、远程工具、会话调查或注释的主流程。

skills.name: ansight-app-inspection-react-native
skills.description: Add React Native and Expo development-build semantics to an Ansight operation. Use alongside a selected core Ansight workflow when React component, shadow-tree, native hierarchy, navigation, memory, or React tool behavior affects interpretation; do not use as the primary live-operation, remote-tool, session-investigation, or annotation workflow.
headings: Keep The Core Workflow In Charge
skills.description_zh: 为已选 Ansight 核心流程补充 React Native 与 Expo 开发构建语义，解释 React 组件、影子树、原生层级、导航、内存和工具行为；不是实时操作、远程工具、会话调查或注释的主流程。

skills.name: ansight-app-inspection
skills.description: Route an ambiguous Ansight app request to the narrowest live-operation, remote-tool, session-investigation, annotation, readiness-audit, workspace-automation, or platform-inspection skill. Use only when the request does not already identify the required Ansight workflow.
skills.description_zh: 仅在请求未指定 Ansight 工作流时，将含糊应用请求路由至最小适用的实时操作、远程工具、会话调查、注释、就绪审计、工作区自动化或平台检查技能。

skills.name: ansight-assess-automation-readiness
skills.description: Audit and score an app's Ansight integration strength and automation readiness. Use for a requested evidence-backed readiness score, automation-ID coverage assessment, blocker analysis, comparison, or prioritized remediation plan; do not use for routine app inspection or workspace authoring.
skills.description_zh: 依据证据审计并评分应用的 Ansight 集成强度和自动化就绪程度，评估自动化 ID 覆盖、阻碍、比较和优先整改计划；不用于日常应用检查或编写工作区。

skills.name: ansight-cli-setup
skills.description: Prepare a developer workstation or agent to use the Ansight CLI by verifying the executable and dependencies, starting or reusing the resident host, and proving structured discovery. Use when setup or setup troubleshooting is requested; do not use for ordinary app operation once they work.
skills.description_zh: 为开发工作站或智能体配置 Ansight CLI，核查可执行文件和依赖、启动或复用常驻主机并验证结构化发现；用于设置和设置故障排查，不用于配置正常后的日常应用操作。

skills.name: ansight-create-remote-tool-android
skills.description: Use this skill when implementing a custom Ansight remote tool for a native Android Kotlin or Java app. Create a narrow androidSimpleTool or AndroidTool with a stable id, explicit read/write/critical ToolPolicy, structured JSON results, local-development build-variant gating, runtime ToolGuard access, registration through AnsightOptions.addTool/addTools or AnsightRuntime.registerTool, and verification through the Ansight CLI.
skills.name_hint: ansight · 创建 · remote · tool · android
skills.description_zh: 为原生 Android Kotlin/Java 应用实现范围窄的 Ansight 自定义远程工具，使用 androidSimpleTool 或 AndroidTool、稳定 ID、明确读/写/关键策略、结构化 JSON、仅本地开发构建启用及运行时 ToolGuard；通过 AnsightOptions 或 AnsightRuntime 注册并用 CLI 验证。

skills.name: ansight-create-remote-tool-cordova
skills.description: Use this skill when implementing a custom Ansight remote tool for a Cordova-family Capacitor app. Create a narrow JavaScript registerTool handler with a stable id, explicit read/write/critical policy, structured results, development-only registration, runtime guard access, and CLI verification.
headings: Ansight Cordova / Capacitor Remote Tool Skill
skills.name_hint: ansight · 创建 · remote · tool · cordova
skills.description_zh: 为 Cordova 系列 Capacitor 应用实现范围窄的 Ansight 自定义远程工具：JavaScript registerTool 处理器、稳定 ID、明确读/写/关键策略、结构化结果、仅开发环境注册及运行时保护，并通过 CLI 验证。

skills.name: ansight-create-remote-tool-dotnet
skills.description: Use this skill when implementing a custom Ansight remote tool for a .NET MAUI, .NET for Android, .NET for iOS, or .NET Mac Catalyst app. Create a narrow Ansight.Tools.ITool implementation with stable tool ids, ToolSchema arguments and results, the shared read/write/critical ToolPolicy, local-development MSBuild gating with AnsightRemoteToolsPolicy, registration through AddTool/AddTools or a WithMyAppTools extension, and verification through the Ansight CLI.
skills.name_hint: ansight · 创建 · remote · tool · dotnet
skills.description_zh: 为 .NET MAUI、Android、iOS 或 Mac Catalyst 应用实现范围窄的 Ansight.Tools.ITool，使用稳定 ID、ToolSchema 参数结果和共享读/写/关键策略；以 AnsightRemoteToolsPolicy 限制本地开发 MSBuild，通过 AddTool/AddTools 或 WithMyAppTools 注册并用 CLI 验证。

skills.name: ansight-create-remote-tool-flutter
skills.description: Use this skill when implementing a custom Ansight remote tool for a Flutter app. Create a narrow Dart registerTool handler with a stable id, explicit read/write/critical policy, structured results, development-only registration, runtime guard access, and CLI verification.
skills.name_hint: ansight · 创建 · remote · tool · flutter
skills.description_zh: 为 Flutter 实现范围窄的 Dart registerTool 远程处理器，提供稳定 ID、明确读/写/关键策略、结构化结果、仅开发环境注册及运行时保护，并用 Ansight CLI 验证。

skills.name: ansight-create-remote-tool-ios
skills.description: Use this skill when implementing a custom Ansight remote tool for a native iOS SwiftUI or UIKit app. Create a narrow AnsightTool with a stable descriptor id, explicit read/write/critical policy, structured result payloads, Debug or local-development build gating, runtime tool guard access, registration through AnsightRuntime.shared.registerTool, and verification through the Ansight CLI.
skills.name_hint: ansight · 创建 · remote · tool · ios
skills.description_zh: 为 iOS SwiftUI/UIKit 实现范围窄的 AnsightTool，提供稳定描述符 ID、明确读/写/关键策略、结构化结果、Debug 或本地开发构建门禁及运行时保护；通过 AnsightRuntime.shared.registerTool 注册并用 CLI 验证。

skills.name: ansight-create-remote-tool-react-native
skills.description: Use this skill when implementing a custom Ansight remote tool for a React Native app. Create a narrow JavaScript-backed registerTool handler or a native Swift/Kotlin tool, use stable ids, explicit read/write/critical policy, structured results, developer-only registration with __DEV__ or native build gates, runtime ToolGuard access, and verification through the Ansight CLI.
headings: Ansight React Native Remote Tool Skill
skills.name_hint: ansight · 创建 · remote · tool · react · native
skills.description_zh: 为 React Native 实现范围窄的 JavaScript registerTool 或原生 Swift/Kotlin 远程工具，提供稳定 ID、明确读/写/关键策略和结构化结果，以 __DEV__ 或原生构建限制开发环境并使用 ToolGuard，最后通过 CLI 验证。

skills.name: ansight-install-android
skills.description: Install the native Android Ansight SDK with automatic emulator registration and one-shot CLI QR enrollment for physical devices. Add the aggregate dependency, initialize from Application, expose the SDK scanner from a developer-only surface, keep remote tools development-only, verify the Gradle build, and inspect the app through the Ansight CLI.
skills.description_zh: 安装 Android Ansight SDK，自动注册模拟器并以 CLI 二维码一次登记实体设备；添加聚合依赖、从 Application 初始化，在开发者专用界面提供扫描器，远程工具仅开发可用，核验 Gradle 构建并通过 CLI 检查应用。

skills.name: ansight-install-cordova
skills.description: Install @ansight/capacitor with automatic simulator or emulator registration and one-shot CLI QR enrollment for physical devices. Add and sync the Capacitor bridge, initialize native defaults, expose enrollFromQrCode from a developer-only surface, keep remote tools development-only, verify web and native builds, and inspect the app through the Ansight CLI.
skills.description_zh: 安装 @ansight/capacitor，自动注册模拟器并以 CLI 二维码一次登记实体设备；添加同步桥、初始化原生默认项，在开发者界面提供 enrollFromQrCode，远程工具仅开发可用，核验 Web 和原生构建并通过 CLI 检查。

skills.name: ansight-install-dotnet
skills.description: Install Ansight in a .NET MAUI, Android, iOS, or Mac Catalyst app with automatic local CLI-host registration and one-shot QR enrollment for physical devices. Add the all-in-one package, initialize at app startup, expose the SDK scanner from a developer-only surface, keep remote tools development-only, verify target builds, and inspect the app through the Ansight CLI.
skills.description_zh: 在 .NET MAUI、Android、iOS 或 Mac Catalyst 安装 Ansight，自动注册本地 CLI 主机并一次二维码登记实体设备；添加一体包、启动初始化、开发者界面提供扫描器，远程工具仅开发可用，核验目标构建并用 CLI 检查应用。

skills.name: ansight-install-flutter
skills.description: Install ansight_flutter with automatic simulator or emulator registration and one-shot CLI QR enrollment for physical devices. Add the package, initialize the runtime and instrumentation, expose enrollFromQrCode from a developer-only surface, configure required native privacy declarations, verify Flutter and native builds, and inspect the app through the Ansight CLI.
skills.description_zh: 安装 ansight_flutter，自动注册模拟器并一次二维码登记实体设备；初始化运行时和仪表化，在开发者界面提供 enrollFromQrCode，配置必要原生隐私声明，核验 Flutter 和原生构建并用 CLI 检查。

skills.name: ansight-install-ios
skills.description: Install the native iOS Ansight SDK with automatic Simulator registration and one-shot CLI QR enrollment for physical devices. Add the aggregate SwiftPM product or pod, initialize from app startup, expose the SDK scanner from a developer-only surface, add only Apple-required privacy descriptions, verify the build, and inspect the app through the Ansight CLI.
skills.description_zh: 安装原生 iOS Ansight SDK，自动注册 Simulator 并一次二维码登记实体设备；添加聚合 SwiftPM 产品或 pod、启动初始化，在开发者界面提供扫描器，仅添加 Apple 要求的隐私说明，核验构建并用 CLI 检查应用。

skills.name: ansight-install-react-native
skills.description: Install @ansight/react-native in React Native or Expo development builds with automatic simulator or emulator registration and one-shot CLI QR enrollment for physical devices. Add and link the package, initialize native defaults, expose enrollFromQrCode from a developer-only surface, keep remote tools development-only, verify JavaScript and native builds, and inspect the app through the Ansight CLI.
skills.description_zh: 在 React Native 或 Expo 开发构建安装 @ansight/react-native，自动注册模拟器并一次二维码登记实体设备；添加链接包、初始化原生默认项，在开发者界面提供 enrollFromQrCode，远程工具仅开发可用，核验 JS 和原生构建并用 CLI 检查。

skills.name: ansight-install
skills.description: Use this skill when installing or configuring Ansight but the app platform has not been selected yet. Install the Ansight CLI with the official platform script when needed, run ansight doctor to identify environment dependencies, obtain approval before installing missing tools, route to the matching platform-specific SDK skill, and finish with CLI enrollment and structured session verification.
skills.description_zh: 在尚未确定应用平台时安排 Ansight 安装配置：必要时使用官方平台脚本装 CLI，运行 ansight doctor 识别依赖，安装缺失工具前获批准，转交匹配平台的 SDK 技能，最后完成 CLI 登记及结构化会话验证。

skills.name: ansight-investigate-session
skills.description: Investigate one live or recorded Ansight session through retained evidence. Use to bracket and correlate logs, network, telemetry, screenshots, trees, touches, artifacts, and annotations or create an evidence slice; do not use to prepare the workstation, drive the live UI, or write annotations.
skills.description_zh: 通过保留证据调查一个实时或录制 Ansight 会话，界定并关联日志、网络、遥测、截图、树、触摸、产物和注释，或生成证据片段；不用于配置工作站、操作实时 UI 或写注释。

skills.name: ansight-operate-live-app
skills.description: Operate an Ansight-connected app through its live lifecycle or visible semantic UI while preserving before-and-after evidence. Use to boot a target, launch or stop an app, resolve a live session, interact, or verify visible state; do not use merely to prepare the CLI, analyze a recording, or call app-internal remote tools.
headings: Operate A Live App With Ansight
skills.description_zh: 通过实时生命周期和可见语义 UI 操作 Ansight 应用，保留前后证据，支持启动目标、开停应用、确定会话、交互和验证可见状态；不用于仅准备 CLI、分析录制或调用内部远程工具。

skills.name: ansight-ui-testing
skills.description: Initialize, author, extract, debug, validate, run, or maintain source-controlled Ansight workspace automation. Use for tests, tasks, triggers, trends, sanitizers, schemas, or workspace registration; do not use for routine live interaction, session investigation, or readiness scoring unless needed to build or verify a workspace asset.
headings: Inspect And Initialize With The CLI
Ground UI Selectors In Recorded Evidence
Execute Through An Existing Interactive Connection
Extract A Task From Recorded Behavior
Debug Or Repair Only When In Scope
Trends: Deterministic Metrics And Regression Evidence
skills.description_zh: 初始化、编写、提取、调试、验证、运行或维护版本控制下的 Ansight 工作区自动化，涵盖测试、任务、触发器、趋势、清理器、模式及注册；不用于日常实时交互、会话调查或就绪评分，除非为建立或验证工作区产物所需。

skills.name: ansight-use-remote-app-tools
skills.description: Discover and call bundled or app-specific remote tools exposed by one connected Ansight session. Use for authoritative in-process framework or domain state and authorized remote operations; do not use merely to establish the host/session, implement new tools, or replace a visible UI workflow.
headings: Decide When A Remote Tool Is Appropriate
Recognize Bundled Families Without Assuming Them
skills.description_zh: 发现并调用一个已连接 Ansight 会话的内置或应用专用远程工具，以读取权威进程内框架和领域状态或执行已授权操作；不用于仅建主机会话、开发新工具或替代可见 UI 流程。
